Just under half an acre, fenced, level and on a corner in Burien.

12005 5th Ave S was built in 1938. Today it lives as a two-bedroom, one-bath home on the main level, with a partially finished basement that has its own entrance. Enjoy it as it is, or picture what the lower level could become: more living space, a rec room, a studio.

Outside: fruit trees, garden space, RV parking and outbuildings for storage and hobbies, on 0.43 acre. R2 zoning gives you more to explore over time (verify zoning and any plans with the city).

Want to walk the lot? Send me a message and I’ll set up a private showing. Every photo is at homes.ranchpnw.com/12005.

Chris Ranch · The Ranch Real Estate Group · (253) 335-5630
Keller Williams Realty Puget Sound
